integrity: A deterministic Python-standard-library verifier fully enumerates the finite complex and proves acyclicity and a primitive integral Morse differential; the homotopy deduction uses ordinary non-equivariant CW attachment theory.
scientific_limitations: Exact twelve-vertex icosahedral graph and ordinary four-cut complex only; no general Platonic-graph family or equivariant homotopy result. Unindexed equivalent literature may exist.
title: The ordinary four-cut complex of the icosahedral graph is a mixed-dimensional sphere wedge
